newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria 1996 state industrial output down 3.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria 1996 state industrial output down 3.3 pct.

text.p: Bulgarian state industrial output fell a real 3.3 percent last year, the National Statistics Institute (NSI) said.
The NSI did not provide figures for receipts from industrial sales.
State industrial production totalled 1,536 billion levs.
Output in both the state and private sectors amounted to 1,766 billion levs, down a real 1.1 percent on 1995 and just 54.7 percent of 1989 industrial output, the NSI said.
The private sector had a 13.3 percent share in total industrial output last year, up from 11.3 percent in 1995.

Ten industries posted a decline in output, with the largest fall of 31.2 percent in the printing industry. Machine building output fell a real 21.8 percent and paper and pulp production shrank 21.4 percent.
Glass and porcelain industry posted a real 19.1 percent rise in 1996, chemical and oil processing output rose six percent and the mining industry posted a real 5.4 percent rise, figures showed.
Total production of goods and services last year amounted to 2,500 billion levs, down a real four percent from 1995. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
